items.particulars: Site Clearance: Site clearance before and after the construction with manual/ Machine including levelling of site, removal of debris etc.
Earth work excavation: Earth work excavation for foundation at 0.6m below ground level at 0.6m width including all labour, Material, lead and lift etc.
PCC Concrete: Placing bed concrete of 1:3:6 grade with 40mm size aggregate including material, labour, transportation, lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.
DR masonry: DR masonry work as foundation with 2feet width including all labour, material, transportation, lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.
RR masonry: RR masonry work as foundation with 2feet width including all labour, material, transportation, lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.
Earth work Filling: Earth work Filling of the foundation including all labour, lead and lift, machine cost etc.

Providing Plinth beam: RCC plinth belt above basement with M20 mix (1:1.5:3) of 150mm thick including all labour, material, Transportation, centring, shuttering, all lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.

Steel work for plinth beam: Steel of 8mm dia steel for main reinforcement and 6mm stirrups for plinth beam inclusive of all fabrication, bending, straightening, transportation, labour, material, all lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.
Brick masonry: Providing brick masonry of 20mm thick with class A brick in 1:4 ratio mortar mix including all labour, material, scaffolding, lead and lift, loading and unloading, transportation etc.
Parapet wall: Providing brick masonry of 10mm thick with class A brick in 1:4 ratio mortar mix including all labour, material, scaffolding, lead and lift, loading and unloading, transportation etc.

Lintel, Loft & sunshade RCC works: Providing lintels and sunshade above wall openings with M20 mix ratio of 150mm depth including centring and shuttering, labour, material, transportation, lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.

Steel work for lintel and Sunshade: Steel of 8mm dia steel for main reinforcement and 6mm stirrups for lintel beam and 8mm for sunshade inclusive of all fabrication, bending, straightening, transportation, labour, material, all lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.

Roof slab RCC Works: Reinforced cement concrete work of M20 Mix (1:1.5:3) for roofing inclusive of centring and shuttering, labour, material, scaffolding, transportation, lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.

Steel work for concrete: Steel works for slab with 8mm main bars and 8mm distribution bars with 500D grade inclusive of all fabrication works including labour, material, bending, straightening, lead and lift, cutting, transportation, loading and unloading etc.

Plastering: Plastering work for interior walls, exterior walls, ceiling of 1:5 ratio mix with 12mm thickness including all labour, materials, transportation, scaffolding, lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.
Painting: Painting with 2 coats of white wash, a layer of putty and a final finishing course including the cost of labour, material, scaffolding, all lead and lift etc.

Staircase: Reinforced cement concrete work of M20 Mix (1:1.5:3) for roofing inclusive of centring and shuttering, labour, material, scaffolding, transportation, lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.

Steel work for stair case: RCC Steel of 10mm and 8mm dia steel for main reinforcement and 6mm stirrups for lintel beam and 8mm for sunshade inclusive of all fabrication, bending, straightening, transportation, labour, material, all lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.
Flooring & skirting: Floor finishing with vitrified tiles inclusive of transportation, laying and working charges for cutting, moulding and nosing, transportation etc.
Wall openings & Joinery (MD, D1, D2, UPVC Windows GW, W3, W1 & Ventilation V1)
Plumbing and Electrification: Plumbing and electrification charges include with material works and, labour, grooving, cutting, laying etc. soak pit and septic tank included.
Hand Rail Works: Providing hand rails with stainless steel and architectural finish as per the 3D design inclusive of material, labour, cutting and welding, fixing etc.
Septic tank: Traditional type of septic tank with 25 year cycle with 4.5cum capacity. It includes all labour, material, transportation, lead and lift, loading and unloading etc.
Brick masonry: Providing brick masonry of 20mm thick with class A brick in 1:4 ratio mortar mix including all labour, material, scaffolding, lead and lift, loading and unloading, transportation etc.
